     CHAIRMAN’S STATEMENT

     式、經審慎考慮並具透明度之程序。職權範圍亦         formal, considered and transparent procedure for the appointment
     明示禁止就委任新增董事之事宜上，將權力授予         of new directors to the Board. The terms of reference also explicitly

     本集團之薪酬政策                 The Group’s Remuneration Policy

     本集團之薪酬政策旨在為僱員維持與市場條件相    The Group’s policy on remuneration is to maintain fair and competitive
     若、公平且具競爭力之薪酬配套，並根據業務需    packages for its employees, which are commensurate with market
     要、專業才能、個人之素質，且參照行業慣例與    terms, and are based on business needs, expertise and quality of
     監管指引而訂立。                 the individuals, and with proper reference to industry practice and
                              regulatory guidelines.


     就釐定支付予董事會成員之袍金水平而言，將會    For determining the level of fees paid to members of the Board of
     考慮市場的袍金水平及各董事之工作量及其須作    Directors, market rates and factors such as each director’s workload
     出之承擔等因素。釐定執行董事薪酬待遇之考慮    and required commitment will be taken into account. The following
     因素如下：                    factors are considered when determining the remuneration packages
                              of EDs:


     －   業務需要及表現              –    Business needs and performance


     －   整體經濟及商業情況            –    The economy and business conditions in general


     －   個別對本集團之貢獻            –    Each individual’s contributions to the Group


     －   風險相關之表現              –	Risk related performance


     －   參考與個人職責相符之市場薪酬水平     –	Reference to market pay level commensurate with the
                                   individual’s responsibility


     －   遵行監管指引               –	Consideration of regulatory guidelines


     －   留任之考慮因素及個別之潛能        –	Retention considerations and each individual’s potential


     於考慮過程中，董事不可參與有關其本人薪酬之    During the process of consideration, no individual director will be
     決定。                      involved in decisions relating to his/her own remuneration.

董事會成員多元化政策                 Board Diversity Policy

董事會於2013年12月3日採納董事會成員多元化   The Board has adopted a Board Diversity Policy (the “Policy”) on 3
政策（「本政策」），其主要條款如下：         December 2013. The key terms of this Policy are set out as follows:


1.   目的                    1.    Purpose

     本政策旨在列載本公司董事會為達致成員          This Policy aims to set out the approach to achieve diversity
     多元化而採取的方針，從而有利於本公司          on the Company’s Board in order to enhance the quality of
     及其整體業務，並提升公司的表現素質。          its performance which in turn benefits the Company and its
                                 business as a whole.


2.   政策聲明                  2.    Policy statement

     本公司明白並深信董事會成員多元化對支          The Company recognizes and embraces the benefits of having
     持實現可持續發展裨益良多。董事會成員          a diverse Board in supporting the attainment of its sustainable
     多元化有多方面的考慮因素，包括但不限          development. Board diversity has been considered from a
     於性別、年齡、種族、文化及教育背景、          number of aspects, including but not limited to gender, age,
     專業經驗、技能、知識及服務任期。董事          ethnicity, cultural and educational background, professional
     會所有委任均以用人唯才為原則，並在考          experience, skills, knowledge and length of service. All Board
     慮人選時以客觀條件充分顧及上述之個人          appointments will be based on meritocracy, and candidates will
     素質因素、對董事會貢獻之期望及董事會          be considered against objective criteria, having due regard for
     成員多元化的裨益。                   the factors on personal attributes outlined above, expectation
                                 on contribution to the Board, and the benefit of diversity of the
                                 Board.


3.   可計量目標                 3.    Measurable Objectives

     甄選人選將按一系列多元化範疇為基準，          Selection of candidates will be based on a range of diversity
     包括但不限於性別、年齡、種族、文化及          perspectives, including but not limited to gender, age, ethnicity,
     教育背景、專業經驗、技能、知識、獨立          cultural and educational background, professional experience,
     性及服務任期。最終將按人選的長處及可          skills, knowledge, independence and length of service. The
     為董事會提供的貢獻而作決定。              ultimate decision will be based on merit and contribution that
                                 the selected candidates will bring to the Board.


4.   監察及匯報                 4.    Monitoring and Reporting

     提名及薪酬委員會將每年向董事會在企業          The NRC will review and report annually, in the corporate
     管治報告內審議及匯報本政策概要、實行          governance report to the Board, a summary of the Policy, the
     本政策之可計量目標及達標進度。             measurable objectives to implement the Policy and progress
                                 made towards achieving those objectives.


5.   檢討本政策                 5.    Review of the Policy

     提名及薪酬委員會將在適時檢討本政策，          The NRC will review the Policy, as appropriate, to ensure the
     以確保本政策行之有效，討論和提出修訂          effectiveness of the Policy and discuss and recommend any
     建議，供董事會審批。                  revisions that may be required to the Board for consideration
                                 and approval.

     社會及管治方面之重大事宜及措施。本報告涵蓋            and a balanced presentation of the Group’s material ESG matters and

     環境、社會及管治的理念                      Our Philosophy in ESG

     大新集團的環境、社會及管治理念貫徹在日常營            The ESG philosophy of the Dah Sing Group is embedded in our
     運中。我們致力於在經濟增長與公司發展及社區            day-to-day operations. It is about striving to reach a balance
     利益與環境保護之間取得平衡，更將可持續發展            between economic and company growth, community interest and
     視為對本集團長遠發展策略及營運上的重要一環。           environmental protection, and treating sustainability both strategically
                                      and operationally on importance, and for the long-term development
                                      of the Group.


     我們的可持續發展方向由高級管理層成員及本集            Our sustainable development direction is overseen by the Corporate
     團若干業務及支援部門主管組成之企業社會責任            Social Responsibility Committee (“CSR Committee”), which
     委員會監督，適時對環境、社會及管治相關風險            comprises members of senior management and certain heads
     的性質及範圍進行評估及審閱。我們已制定風險            of Business and Support functions of the Group. The nature and
     管理及內部監控系統，以管理及控制風險以實現            extent of ESG related risks are evaluated and reviewed whenever
     業務目標。我們亦已制定營商原則和價值觀的標            appropriate. Risk management and internal control systems are in
     準，把可持續發展承諾貫徹在日常業務營運中。            place to manage and control the risk of failure to achieve business
     我們設有企業社會責任政策，為本集團企業社會            objectives. A standard riding on our Guiding Principles and Values,
     責任與業務營運之間取得平衡策略發展提供指引。           and thus embodying our sustainability commitment in our daily

實際利率法乃是一種用以計算金融資產或金融負     The effective interest method is a method of calculating the amortised
債之攤餘成本及其於相關期內攤分利息收入或利     cost of a financial asset or a financial liability and of allocating the

所有其他溢價或折讓。                losses. The calculation includes all fees and points paid or received
                          between parties to the contract that are an integral part of the effective
                          interest rate, transaction costs and all other premiums or discounts.

最主要之風險類別為信貸風險、流動資金風險、      The most important types of risk are credit risk, liquidity risk, market
市場風險和操作風險。市場風險包括外匯風險、      risk and operational risk. Market risk includes currency risk, interest
利率風險及其他定價風險。               rate risk and other price risks.


3.1 應用金融工具策略               3.1 Strategy in using financial instruments

本集團接受定息或浮息及不同年期之客戶存款，      The Group accepts deposits from customers at both fixed and floating
並以此取得之資金投資於各種類別的資產以賺取      rates, and for various periods, and seeks to earn positive interest
息差收入。本集團尋求透過整合短期資金及按較      margins by investing and lending these funds in a wide range of
高利率借出較長期之款項以增加此等息差收入，      assets. The Group seeks to increase these margins by consolidating
同時並保持足夠之流動資金以應付可能須付之所      short-term funds and lending for longer periods at higher rates, while
有到期債務。                     maintaining sufficient liquidity to meet all claims that might fall due.


本集團亦按信貸風險及市場情況，透過向商業及      The Group also seeks to apply its interest margins through its
零售借款人貸款賺取息差，以及向客戶收取合理      lending to commercial and retail borrowers and to charge customers
費用及佣金。此等活動風險不單涉及資產負債表      appropriate fees and commission, taking into consideration credit risk
內之貸款及墊款，亦涉及本集團提供擔保及其他      and market conditions. Such exposures involve not just on-balance
承擔，例如信用證、履約保證及其他保證。        sheet loans and advances, as the Group also enters into guarantees
                           and other commitments such as letters of credit, performance bonds
                           and other bonds.


本集團亦通過交易所及場外交易（「場外交易」）買    The Group also trades in financial instruments where it takes positions
賣包括衍生工具之金融工具，藉著證券、債券、      in exchange-traded and over-the-counter (“OTC”) instruments,
貨幣及利率之短期波動賺取利潤。董事會制定交      including derivatives, to take advantage of short-term market
易限額以控制不同程度之市場持倉風險。除指定      movements in equities and bonds and in currencies and interest rates.

對銷持倉（包括與客戶及市場對手之交易）或利用     be taken in relation to market positions. Apart from specific hedging
衍生工具作對沖，藉此控制有關市場持倉套現之      arrangements, foreign exchange and interest rate exposures are
現金淨值。                      normally offset by entering into counterbalancing positions (including
                           transactions with customers or market counterparties), or by the

本集團亦應用利率掉期及其他利率衍生工具以減      The Group also uses interest rate swap and other interest rate
輕因利率變動令定息資產公平值下降或定息負債      derivatives to mitigate interest rate risk arising from changes in
公平值上升之利率風險。若干金融工具被用作公      interest rates that will result in decrease in the fair value of fixed rate
平值對沖，對沖項目之細節，包括被對沖項目、      assets or increase in the fair value of fixed rate liabilities. Part of
金額、利率、對沖期及目的，皆於各公平值對沖      these financial instruments are designated as fair value hedges, and

值對沖失效日起停止。                 basis, based on actual experience and valuation. Fair value hedge

      3.5 金融資產及負債之公平值                                    3.5 Fair values of financial assets and liabilities

           （甲） 公平值之釐定                                           (a)   Determination of fair value

            公平值受限於須由董事會負責確保本集團                                  Fair values are subject to a control framework that the Board is
            有適當的估值管治及控制程序之控制框                                   held responsible for ensuring proper valuation governance and
            架。董事會授權財資及投資風險委員會監                                  control processes of the Group. It delegates the responsibility
            管金融工具之估值程序。估值由風險管理                                  for overseeing the valuation process for financial instruments to
            及監控部和獨立專業合資格估值師（如適                                  the TIRC. Valuation is performed independently by RMCD and
            用）獨立地進行，而估值結果乃定期驗證，                                 where appropriate, by independent and professionally qualified
            確保公平值計量過程之完整性。                                      valuers and the valuation results are periodically verified to
                                                                ensure the integrity of the fair value measurement process.


            金融工具之公平值乃在目前市場情況下市                                  The fair value of financial instruments is the price that would be
            場參與者於計量日進行之有序交易中出售                                  received to sell an asset or paid to transfer a liability in an orderly
            資產所收取或轉移負債所支付之價格，不                                  transaction between market participants at the measurement
            論該價格為直接可觀察或使用估值方法估                                  date under current market conditions regardless of whether
            計。                                                  that price is directly observable or estimated using a valuation
                                                                technique.


            凡金融工具之報價隨時且定期由交易所、                                  A financial instrument is regarded as quoted in an active market
            交易商、經紀人、行業組織、定價服務及                                  if quoted prices are readily and regularly available from an
            監管機構發佈，則被視作為活躍市場報價                                  exchange, dealer, broker, industry group, pricing service or
            之 金 融 工 具。 於 活 躍 市 場 之 報 價 為 公 平                    regulatory agency. A quoted price in an active market provides
            值提供最可靠之證據，並須於可獲得時使                                  the most reliable evidence of fair value and shall be used
            用。倘金融資產或金融負債有買入價及賣                                  whenever available. If a financial asset or a financial liability has
            出價，本集團將採用買賣差價中在該等情                                  a bid price and an ask price, the price within the bid-ask spread
            況下最能代表公平值之價格。                                       that is most representative of fair value in the circumstances is
                                                                used by the Group.


            倘金融工具之可觀察市場報價未能直接獲                                  Where observable market quotation of financial instruments is
            得，本集團利用合適及獲廣泛認可之估值                                  not directly available, the Group estimates the fair value of such
            方法估計該等金融工具之公平值，包括現                                  financial instruments by using appropriate valuation techniques

      就編製分項報告而言，對可直接認明為各個別分                              For the purpose of segment reporting, revenue derived from
      項之源自客戶、產品及服務收入，將直接呈報於                              customers, products and services directly identifiable with individual
      有關分項；而分項之間的資金運用及資金資源所                              segments are reported directly under respective segments, while
      產生的收入和資金成本，按參照市場利率之轉移                              revenue and funding cost arising from inter-segment funding
      價格機制分配至各分項。分項間之交易乃依據授                              operation and funding resources are allocated to segments by way
      予第三者或與第三者交易之同類條款定價。分項                              of transfer pricing mechanism with reference to market interest rates.
      間之收入或支出於綜合賬內抵銷。                                    Transactions within segments are priced based on similar terms
                                                         offered to or transacted with external parties. Inter-segment income
                                                         or expenses are eliminated on consolidation.


      所有不同分項之直接開支將歸類於有關的分項分                              All direct costs incurred by different segments are grouped under
      類。間接開支及支援部門開支乃依據開支性質，                              respective segments. Indirect costs and support functions’ costs are
      按耗用之時間及工作量和分項營運收入，分配至                              allocated to various segments and products based on effort and time
      不同的分項及產品。不能合理地分配至各分項、                              spent as well as segments’ operating income depending on the nature
      產品及支援部門之企業活動開支，則作企業開支                              of costs incurred. Costs related to corporate activities that cannot be
      呈列於「其他」項下。                                         reasonably allocated to segments, products and support functions

（乙）投資之減值測試及於 2018 年確認之減           (b)   Impairment testing on the investment and impairment
   值                                    recognised in 2018

於 2018 年 12 月 31 日，本集團在重慶銀行之投資    At 31 December 2018, the fair value of the Group’s investment in
之公平值已低於賬面值大約 60 個月。為此，本集          BOCQ had been below the carrying amount for approximately 60
團持續對在重慶銀行之投資之賬面值進行減值測             months. On this basis, the Group continues to perform an impairment
試以評估可收回金額。根據於2016年及之前進行           test on the carrying amount of the investment in BOCQ to assess the
之評估，可收回金額被評定為高於賬面值，故無             recoverable amount. Based on the assessment conducted in 2016
需確認減值。                            and before, the recoverable amount was assessed as higher than the
                                  carrying amount, and no impairment needed to be recognised.


減值測試比對以計算使用價值而釐定之重慶銀行             The impairment test is performed by comparing the recoverable
可收回金額和該投資之賬面值。使用價值乃按照             amount of BOCQ, determined by a value in use (“VIU”) calculation,
管理層估量之重慶銀行盈利和未來將派股息，及             with the carrying amount of the investment. The VIU calculation uses
經考慮重慶銀行中期和長期之增長及資產淨值後             discounted cash flow projections based on management’s estimates
之預期未來的可能脫手價值，應用貼現現金流量             of BOCQ’s earnings and dividends to be paid in future, and the
預測計算。應用於使用價值計算之貼現率乃參考             estimated probable exit value in future after considering the growth
可於公開市場獲取之重慶銀行股本成本而估算。             of BOCQ and its net asset value for the medium and longer term.
                                  The discount rate applied to the VIU calculation was estimated with
                                  reference to BOCQ’s cost of equity, which is publicly available in the
                                  market.

      39. 儲備（續）                                                                       39. Reserves (Continued)
      註：                                                                              Note:


      大新銀行為香港註冊銀行須以監管儲備形式維持除香港                                                        DSB as a locally incorporated bank in Hong Kong is required to maintain
      財務報告準則所需以外之最低減值撥備。維持該監管儲                                                        minimum impairment provisions in excess of those required under HKFRS
      備（儲備包括澳門商業銀行及大新銀行（中國））乃為符合                                                      in the form of regulatory reserve. The regulatory reserve, which also covers
      香港銀行業條例及以審慎監管為目的之本地監管規定。                                                        BCM and DSB China, is maintained to satisfy the provisions of the Hong Kong
      該監管儲備規限可派發予股東之儲備金額。監管儲備之                                                        Banking Ordinance and local regulatory requirements for prudential supervision
      變動須與香港金管局進行諮詢，並直接於權益儲備內調                                                        purposes. The regulatory reserve restricts the amount of reserves which can
      撥。                                                                              be distributed to shareholders. Movements in the regulatory reserve are made

      45. 金融資產與負債的對銷                                     45. Offsetting financial assets and financial

      倘若有法律上強制性執行的權利可對銷金融資產                              Financial assets and liabilities are presented net when there is a legally
      及負債之已確認金額，以及有意以淨額基準對其                              enforceable right to offset the recognised amounts and there is an
      結算或同時變現資產及清償負債，則可將金融資                              intention to settle them on a net basis, or realise the asset and settle
      產及負債相互對銷。                                          the liability simultaneously.


      （甲）依淨額結算協議處理並已在財務狀況                                (a)    Financial assets and liabilities subject to netting
         表內對銷之金融資產及負債                                           agreement and offset on the statement of financial
                                                                position

      總體淨額結算安排                                           Master netting arrangements

      本集團會盡可能與交易對手訂立總體淨額結算安                              To mitigate credit risks, the Group enters into master netting
      排，以減低信貸風險。淨額結算協議規定，一旦                              arrangements with counterparties whenever possible. Netting
      出現違約事件，所有涉及交易對手之未完成交易                              agreements provide that, if an event of default occurs, all outstanding
      均會終止，而所有結欠款項將拼合按淨額結算。                              transactions with the counterparty will be terminated and all amounts
      如非發生違約事件，所有與對手之交易會以總額                              outstanding will be settled on a net basis. Except for the event of
      結算及一般不會在財務狀況表中對銷資產及負
                                                         default, all outstanding transactions with the counterparty are settled
      債。
                                                         on a gross basis and generally do not result in offsetting the assets
                                                         and liabilities in the statement of financial position.

外分行，而其總部是處於不同的國家，才會確認                               is recognised if the claims against a counterparty are guaranteed by
